Updating the Link SDK experience

We redesigned our Link SDK to enhance the user experience during the connection and payment steps and improve your conversion rates.

By refining the interface, introducing dark mode, and optimizing for various screen sizes, we strive to deliver a trustworthy and seamless experience for all users, regardless of their device or platform.

2 / 12

Requirements

No changes to your implementation are needed as the rollout will be delivered Over-The-Air via Feature Flags. If any issues arise, we can quickly disable the update.

Link SDK 2.0 is available only for Link Loader implementations. Please ask your implementations manager for migration resources.

The new version will be available to a percentage of customers initially. This percentage will be increased over the following weeks.
